title: Describing clothes
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y9 lesson 31 (Pupil PDF worksheet: describing clothes)
intro: Lesson 31: Describing clothes: colour and agreement. To understand how colour adjectives agree with masculine and feminine nouns

questions.model: Teacher: قُبَّعَة ends in ة, so feminine. Red feminine is حَمْرَاءُ. Together: قُبَّعَةٌ حَمْرَاءُ.

questions.q: Describe five items from a clothes shop photo on the pupil PDF with colour and one more adjective; then describe your school uniform or Eid clothes in three sentences in the portal response box.
questions.a: Correct gender agreement and patterns, for example: مِعْطَفٌ رَمَادِيٌّ قَصِيرٌ؛ عَبَاءَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ جَمِيلَةٌ
questions.model: Teacher does item 1: ثَوْبٌ أَبْيَضُ طَوِيلٌ.
